page.title: Notifications
page.subtitle: Everything that concerns you, in one place.

prefs.title: Notification settings
prefs.description: Choose what you want to hear about. Applies to your account only.
prefs.emailDisabled: E-mail is not configured on this server yet. Once your administrator enables sending, you can choose it here.
prefs.emailModeDesc: One rule above the toggles below — what may reach you by e-mail.
prefs.emailModeInstantDesc: Every checked event is e-mailed right away.
prefs.emailModeDigestDesc: No individual e-mails; one digest arrives once a day.
prefs.emailModeNoneDesc: Nothing is e-mailed. Notifications stay in the app.
prefs.navratTitle: Come-back e-mails when I have not signed in for a while
prefs.navratDesc: After 3, 7, 14 and 30 days without signing in you get an overview of your open work and the smallest steps to get going again. Signing in resets the count.
prefs.emailModeOverridden: Controlled by the e-mail mode above
